newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian palm olein prices lower in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian palm olein prices lower in late trade.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices fell further in late trade on Friday as buyers held back after rumours of government cooking oil imports from Malaysia, traders said.
They said palm olein in Jakarta eased to between 1,490-1,500 rupiah/kg from 1,525-1,550 rupiah/kg in the morning.
"Olein prices continue to drop as buyers are afraid to buy following rumours of cooking oil import from Malaysia. There was no demand so the market has become very very quiet," one trader said.
Traders said palm olein in Medan remained at 1,460 rupiah/kg.
They said prices of crude palm oil (CPO) remained at 1,240 rupiah/kg after a tender on Thursday.
Indonesia's state logistics agency BULOG said on the weekend it planned to intervene in the market to push palm olein prices down in an effort to stabilse cooking oil prices.
